name: Suspicious connection investigation
description: This playbook is executed when an alert for a suspicious outgoing connection attempt from an endpoint is raised. A suspicious connection is any connection to an unusual (high) port that is not specifically allowed. This playbook checks the reputation of the destination IP address and blocks the connection. If the IP belongs to a known malicious server the host is isolated from the network and needs to be investigated further.
